t: Post viral bronchiolitis obliterans in children: A rare and potentially devastating disease - ScienceDirect
s: May 13, 2024 - Post infectious bronchiolitis obliterans (PIBO) is a rare but severe disease in children. Several respiratory pathogens are incriminated but adenovirus is still the most represented. Risk factors are well described: the male gender, hypoxemia at diagnosis and required mechanical ventilation.
